Roll Reason to open an ordinary lock and learn whether it was damaged or tampered with. You can relock it with a Maneuver.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One adjacent ordinary lock.
Equipment / acquisition
Lock tools (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.
Type
Skill / Utility

Make a Reason roll toward opening the lock. Learn whether it shows damage or tampering.

Weak
2 opening progress.
Standard
3 opening progress.
Strong
4 opening progress.

Once you open it this way, you may relock it with your tools in a Maneuver.
